pois.name: Stalactite gallery
pois.note: Game scan contact at the authored karst-grotto prop, on the locally carved ledge. Submerged stalactite galleries are documented at the real Blue Hole, but this marker's coordinate and geometry are not a surveyed gallery location.

pois.name: Eastern atoll drop-off
pois.note: Real survey terrain: about 4.3 km east of the hole marker, the reef flat gives way to a steep drop-off, from a few metres deep to about 196 m here and falling to well over 3,000 m further out. This transition is genuine atoll-margin bathymetry, resolved at this tile's ~58 x 61 m cell size.

pois.name: Western atoll drop-off
pois.note: Real GMRT terrain on the western edge of Lighthouse Reef: along 17.3153 N, the floor remains 2-4 m deep from the hole coordinate to about 87.58 W, then drops to about 30 m at 87.59 W and about 304 m at 87.60 W. This target is 157 m deep on the visible western slope, about 6.5 km west of the hole coordinate.
